heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy from the Adirondacks and Route 2 northward, with the chance of a shower or thunderstorm; partly cloudy to the south, with the slight chance of a shower or storm down to around Route 4. Highs in the low to mid 80s in the south, and upper 70s to lower 80s north. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy. Slight chance of an early shower or thunderstorm near and north of Route 4. Areas of valley fog. Lows from the mid 50s to lower 60s. West to northwest winds around 5 mph early, becoming light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Some early fog, the partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of an afternoon shower near the Massachusetts border, slight chance north to Route 4. Highs from the mid 70s to around 80, some lower 70s far north. Winds variable to west at around 5 mph.
